en.t: Since there is such refined pleasure, why not enjoy it together?"

units.source_text: 源氏看了信说道：“我致仕以来，身无拘束；冷泉院退位之后，闲居逸处。

en.t: Genji read the letter and said, "Since retiring from office, I have been free of obligations; after Reizei-in stepped down from the throne, he too has lived quietly at ease.

units.source_text: 我不曾常去访晤，他心中定然不快，因此来信相邀，实在不胜抱歉。”

en.t: Because I have not often gone to visit him, he must surely feel displeased; now that he has sent a letter inviting me, I am truly deeply sorry."
He then immediately rose and prepared to go.
